claim: Middle-positioned information suffers 10-40% reduced recall accuracy in long-context experiments
notes: Percentages vary by model family and context length. Revalidate when new model generations release.

claim: Multi-agent systems cost 10-50x more tokens than single-agent chat for complex tasks
source: Production deployment data and LangGraph benchmarks
notes: Multiplier depends heavily on coordination pattern and task complexity. Revalidate with new orchestration frameworks.

claim: Reducing specialized tools to a smaller primitive tool set improved measured outcomes in production
notes: Specific reduction ratios vary by domain.

claim: Token usage, tool calls, and model choice dominate performance variance in browsing-agent evaluations
notes: Findings may not generalize to non-browsing agent tasks.

claim: Even a single distractor document triggers measurable performance degradation
notes: Consistent across model families.

claim: Copilot inline completions use a Fixed Window Jaccard Matcher (60-line windows), a priority-ordered Prompt Wishlist, and a logistic-regression contextual filter (~15% threshold)
source: Reverse engineering of Copilot extension v1.57 (June 2022); GitHub engineering blog (May 2023)
notes: Version-specific; newer extension builds may differ.

claim: Copilot routing layer caps usable context below provider maxima and reserves ~30-35% of the window for output
notes: Changes with model picker updates.

claim: Copilot CLI auto-compacts at ~80% capacity with a ~20% buffer, pausing at ~95% until compaction completes
source: GitHub Docs: Managing context in GitHub Copilot CLI
notes: Thresholds may change between CLI releases.

claim: Copilot merges instruction layers in priority order: personal, path-scoped .instructions.md (applyTo), repo copilot-instructions.md, AGENTS.md, org
notes: Customization surface evolves between releases.

claim: Cursor indexes workspaces with a custom embedding model; semantic search becomes available at ~80% index completion with ~5-minute incremental sync
notes: Indexing thresholds may change between Cursor releases.

claim: Cursor Agent compresses older conversation turns into summaries when the context window nears capacity; CLI supports /compress
source: Cursor Docs: Prompting agents, CLI usage (2025-2026)
notes: Compression behavior evolves with Agent updates.

claim: Cursor project rules use .mdc files in .cursor/rules/ with description, globs, and alwaysApply frontmatter; rules apply to Agent (Chat) only, not Tab or Inline Edit
notes: Rule system evolves between Cursor releases.

claim: Kiro loads steering from .kiro/steering/ (workspace) and ~/.kiro/steering/ (global) with inclusion modes: always, fileMatch, manual, and auto
notes: Inclusion modes may expand between Kiro releases.

claim: Kiro spec-driven workflow uses requirements, design, and tasks artifacts as durable context that outlive individual chat sessions
source: Kiro Docs and spec-driven development workflow (2025-2026)
notes: Artifact naming and workflow may evolve.

claim: Kiro steering frontmatter uses inclusion: always|fileMatch|manual|auto; AGENTS.md in steering paths is always included with no scoping
notes: AGENTS.md behavior may change as Kiro adopts standards.

claim: Google Antigravity combines AGENTS.md, Knowledge Items, Skills, and Artifacts (plans, task lists, walkthroughs) as persistent context pillars
notes: Platform context model evolves rapidly.

claim: Antigravity Manager Surface agents produce reviewable Artifacts; feedback on Artifacts is incorporated without stopping execution
notes: Artifact workflow may change between releases.

claim: Antigravity reads AGENTS.md at session start and supports .agents/skills/ with SKILL.md progressive disclosure
notes: Directory layout may standardize further.

claim: Amazon Q CLI matches .amazonq/rules/**/*.md by default and enforces context-file token limits that can block model calls when exceeded
source: AWS Q Developer docs; amazon-q-developer-cli issue #1254 (2025)
notes: Token limits and glob defaults may change.

claim: Amazon Q Developer supports /compact for chat history summarization and nudges compaction at ~80% context capacity in IDE chat
source: AWS Docs: Chat history compaction in Amazon Q Developer
notes: Thresholds may change between releases.

claim: Amazon Q project rules are markdown files in .amazonq/rules/ loaded automatically into IDE and CLI chat context
source: AWS Docs: Creating project rules for Amazon Q Developer
notes: Rule format and CLI agent schema may evolve.
